Records.description: Establishes the one-loop n-point integral in D=n dimensions as the volume of a geodesic simplex in non-Euclidean (hyperbolic) space, the geometric interpretation underlying the whole n-gon family.

Records.authors: J. L. Bourjaily, E. Gardi, A. J. McLeod, C. Vergu
Records.description: Explicit hyperbolic-volume closed forms for the all-mass n-gon via a generalized Gauss-Bonnet theorem (the Gauss-Bonnet pentagon used here).

Records.authors: L. Ren, M. Spradlin, C. Vergu, A. Volovich
Records.description: Explicit polylogarithmic results for one-loop scalar n-gon integrals in n dimensions (even n) via volumes of hyperbolic orthoschemes.

Records.authors: Z. Bern, L. Dixon, D. A. Kosower
Records.description: Dimensionally regulated one-loop scalar n-point integrals; recursion reducing n-point integrals to boxes, a foundation of the n-gon reduction.
